description: Golden fixtures for built-in tool response shapes. Each file follows the naming convention: <category>__<tool_variant>__<params>.json. Fixtures are serde-roundtrippable against the corresponding structs in grodex-tools/src/common.rs.

fixtures.schema: ReadTool output for files fitting entirely within the bounded view (no truncation). Includes FileSnapshot with Whole read_range and a ToolResultEnvelope carrying the full Text model_content.
EditTool successful apply with hashline-anchored hunks. Includes expected_file_version fence, ChangeType=Updated changed_resources entry, and before/after content_hash pair.
Multi-file PatchPlan apply: 3 targets (1 Add, 1 Update, 1 Delete). atomicity=StrictAtomic. Includes plan_hash, per-file PatchHunks with before/after byte ranges.
Short-lived exec (echo "hello world"). exit_code=0, ExecStatus=Success, HeadTailBuffer total output < capacities, so omitted_bytes=0. No full_output_ref.
WriteTool atomic create with fsync. Includes FileSnapshot for the new file (ChangeType=Created), contract_version bump, and retryability=NotRetryable for non-idempotent path.

ReadTool HeadTail output for a 5000-line text log. truncated=true, head[100]=first 100 lines, tail[100]=last 100 lines. FileSnapshot marks oversized file. TruncationStrategy=HeadTail, omitted=4800 lines.

Long-running cargo build (60s timeout fence). exit_code=0, total_output_bytes=2MB > head+tail capacities. Bounded view: head=4KB compile cascade, tail=4KB Finished line + warnings. Includes ProcessHandle with Exited state and lease_expires_at.

conventions.serde_compat_targets: all top-level keys MUST match fields on structs in grodex-tools/src/common.rs; enums use serde default (external tag for ProcessState, internal for FileType, unit-like for ExecStatus)
conventions.head_tail_semantics: When HeadTailBuffer is simulated in fixture JSON, the head/tail strings MUST be valid UTF-8; placeholders like *_TRUNCATED_FOR_BREVITY are permitted as long as the byte-size narrative in total_output_bytes / total_lines holds
conventions.process_state_serialization: ProcessState::Exited(i32) serializes as { "Exited": 0 } under serde default tag; fixture follows same
